read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved. No broad archive read or stale-derived inference. Fresh MISSION_STATE plus exact-current executable/contracts control this review. QUANTUM_LATEST receipt was read after the requested code/contract chain.

material_delta.finding: The direct-credit bypass is not limited to verified Experience. select_gear_v2_1 independently derives operational_progress_delta from caller event_kind for DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND without any durable ledger acceptance, evidence identity, replay protection, or exactly-once receipt. A caller can therefore invoke the decision path repeatedly and inflate operational progress even while verified_experience_delta stays zero. This directly contaminates candidate speed metrics such as durable_progress_per_wake and can manufacture apparent throughput gains without new durable work.
material_delta.required_change: Operational progress must use the same single-authority accepted-event path as verified Experience. select_gear_v2_1 consumes an immutable AcceptedProgressReceipt/AcceptedExperienceReceipt bound to canonical event identity, durable evidence hash, source/install/workspace identity and monotonic acceptance record; without a fresh accepted receipt both verified_experience_delta and operational_progress_delta are zero. Speed metrics must derive from the durable acceptance ledger, never decision-call counts.

agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are classified as operational-only, not verified Experience.
Safety/recovery downshifts are not blocked by the anti-thrash branch because it only suppresses selected_n > current_n.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT keeps speedup status NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED and requires operational metrics rather than commit count or awake time.
Verified Gearbox v1 and Step009 Heartbeat foundation remain preserved by this candidate-only review.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied and not derived from trusted timestamp/TTL/source/authority/replay evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive them from replay-resistant secretary/authority envelopes; caller booleans cannot be routing authority.

disagreements.finding: non-bool freshness/conflict values can exploit Python truthiness.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool values fail-closed before routing, then bind freshness/authority to trusted evidence.

disagreements.finding: verified Experience is controlled by event kind plus a free verification flag without exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent verifier receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require exact canonical evidence/event fingerprint plus trusted verifier receipt and acceptance binding.

disagreements.finding: bool(...) converts nonempty strings/containers such as 'false' into True in verification paths.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool verification values fail-closed; strict bool alone does not replace evidence-bound verifier authority.

disagreements.finding: dedupe trusts caller event_id; the same evidence can be replayed under new IDs.
disagreements.required_change: Canonical evidence lineage plus verifier/acceptance identity must control uniqueness.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events recreates seen=set() every call, so identical events can be re-credited across calls, polls, restarts or rollback.
disagreements.required_change: Use durable replay-resistant accepted-event registry with monotonic rollback protection.

disagreements.finding: event_id is not immutably bound to event kind, evidence and verifier receipt across runs.
disagreements.required_change: Seal canonical EventIdentity on first acceptance; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact replay is no-op.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 independently recomputes verified credit from caller event fields instead of consuming ledger-authorized acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Single-authority accepted-event path; receipt-less decision emits zero verified credit.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 independently recomputes operational progress from caller event_kind, allowing repeated decision calls to fabricate durable_progress throughput and contaminate speed metrics.
disagreements.required_change: Operational progress must also require the same durable monotonic acceptance receipt; decision-call frequency never creates progress.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and can activate or bypass anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift ledger with numerator, denominator, window, sample count, runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: ratio>=0.50 has no sample-size/window/confidence semantics; 1/1 can trigger production hold.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit minimum support, window and release semantics; numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: anti-thrash can indefinitely suppress safe upshift and hide cycle/closure/recovery performance regression.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/release/cooldown and require paired non-regression tests.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently reason-only; future behavioral use could form a self-reinforcing loop.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived over precommitted denominator/window and causal anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability/truth/trust/personality measures.
disagreements.required_change: Forbid aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold; weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.

Compare matched workloads on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk; commit/wake/awake time excluded.

statistical_risks: Repeated decision calls can inflate operational_progress_delta without new durable acceptance, directly biasing durable_progress_per_wake and apparent speedup.
Caller-controlled shift-rate provenance permits anti-thrash activation or bypass bias.
Small-n shift ratios can create false-positive anti-thrash.
Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle/recovery latency or verified closure throughput.
verified_progress_density lacks denominator/window/independence and can become self-reinforcing.
Transient event-id dedupe permits longitudinal inflation across polling/restarts and semantic rebinding.
5/4/3 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not interval-scale capability measurements.
Unmatched speed comparisons are confounded by task mix, incidents, verifier availability, route complexity and runtime conditions.

GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005 stable demand after burst regains safe upshift within bounded policy with non-regressed cycle/closure/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007 caller density=1.0 confers no routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008 same canonical evidence under 10,000 distinct IDs credits once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009 and GB21-SECRETARY-BOOL-COERCION-010 reject non-bool control values.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011 verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier receipt gets zero verified credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013 DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014 equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 paired matched baseline reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit/wake/awake time excluded.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller ratio.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020 prove exactly-once acceptance across calls, restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021 same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact original replay is no-op.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 and DUAL-PATH-CONSISTENCY-023 require decision projection to bind the same acceptance_record_hash as the canonical ledger.

GB21-OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024 call select_gear_v2_1 10,000 times with DURABLE_PROGRESS but no fresh accepted receipt; total operational progress remains zero after the single canonical acceptance and durable_progress_per_wake is unchanged by decision-call count.

GB21-SPEED-METRIC-LEDGER-BINDING-025 compute durable_progress_per_wake only from accepted durable-progress records divided by canonical wake cohort; caller event_kind repetitions, polls and window uptime cannot change numerator.
release_condition: No C PASS claim and no formal/code mutation.
Fresh secretary influence derives from trusted replay-resistant freshness evidence and exact fresh-authority comparison; non-bool freshness/conflict fails closed.
Verified Experience and operational progress share exactly one authoritative durable acceptance path; select_gear_v2_1 cannot create either credit from caller event fields.
Accepted-event uniqueness resists same-evidence/new-ID laundering, same-ID/different-binding rebinding, repeated calls, polling, restart and rollback.
recent_shift_rate is internally derived from canonical shift ledger with precommitted window/sample semantics; anti-thrash cannot hide material cycle/closure/recovery regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and causal/non-self-reinforcing tests pass.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience; P_base stays read-only.
Credit weights remain heuristic TEST_REQUIRED and cannot become promotion/capability/Trust/Identity/Personality truth.

Any speedup claim uses durable acceptance-ledger numerators and requires paired matched baseline on durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with verification/risk non-regression.
